name: strict-prose
description: Enforces plain house writing rules on every file, commit, post and copy reply: no em dashes, hype words, emoji or stock AI phrasing

ignore_paths.title: Ignored paths
ignore_paths.description: Comma-separated path fragments the file check skips (this mod's own rule list is skipped by default)

chat_dashes.title: Rewrite dashes in chat
chat_dashes.description: Replace em and en dashes in Claude's chat replies with commas as they stream

auto_rewrite.title: Auto-rewrite copy replies
auto_rewrite.description: When a reply to a copy request breaks the rules, send it back once for a rewrite
